style: Native redraw: very thick angular navy contours, large hard-edged flat burgundy/plum/ochre/cream blocks, simplified geometric theater details. No procedural color quantization.
coordinateConvention: Logical art slot centred on sprite pivot; upright silhouettes may overhang the art slot inside a larger transparent frame. Paired states share canvas dimensions and bottom baseline.

sources.alphaPolicy: Retain components with at least 100 alpha>=8 pixels, preserving their original antialiasing within two pixels; zero RGB under alpha zero. Generated color planes are unchanged.
